scripts.script:
local Target = game:GetService("Workspace") --SELECT YOUR TARGET
local Output = "-- Generated automatically\nlocal create = Instance.new\nlocal refs = {}\n\n"

local blacklist = {
    ["TouchTransmitter"] = true,
    ["Camera"] = true,
    ["Terrain"] = true,
    ["Workspace"] = true,
    ["Status"] = true,
    ["ManualWeld"] = true,
    ["Weld"] = true,
    ["Motor6D"] = true,
    ["Snap"] = true
}

local defaultCache = {}

local function cleanValue(val)
    if typeof(val) == "string" then
        return '"' .. val .. '"'
    elseif typeof(val) == "Vector3" then
        return "Vector3.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "Vector2" then
        return "Vector2.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "CFrame" then
        return "CFrame.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "Color3" then
        return "Color3.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "BrickColor" then
        return "BrickColor.new(\"" .. tostring(val) .. "\")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "UDim2" then
        return "UDim2.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "UDim" then
        return "UDim.new(" .. tostring(val) .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "NumberRange" then
        return "NumberRange.new(" .. val.Min .. ", " .. val.Max .. ")"
    elseif typeof(val) == "EnumItem" then
        return tostring(val)
    elseif typeof(val) == "Instance" then
        return "nil"
    end
    return tostring(val)
end

local function getProperties(className)
    local props = {}
    if className == "Part" or className == "SpawnLocation" then
        props = {"Name", "Size", "CFrame", "BrickColor", "Shape", "CanCollide", "Anchored", "Material", "Transparency", "CastShadow"}
    elseif className == "MeshPart" or className == "WedgePart" or className == "CornerWedgePart" then
        props = {"Name", "Size", "CFrame", "BrickColor", "CanCollide", "Anchored", "Material", "Transparency", "CastShadow"}
    elseif className == "Decal" or className == "Texture" then
        props = {"Name", "Texture", "Face", "Transparency", "Color3"}
    elseif className == "SpecialMesh" then
        props = {"Name", "MeshId", "TextureId", "MeshType", "Scale", "Offset"}
    elseif className == "PointLight" or className == "SpotLight" or className == "SurfaceLight" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Brightness", "Range", "Enabled", "Shadows"}
    elseif className == "Sound" then
        props = {"Name", "SoundId", "Volume", "PlaybackSpeed", "Playing", "Looped", "PlayingOffset", "RollOffMaxDistance", "RollOffMinDistance", "RollOffMode"}
    elseif className == "Shirt" then
        props = {"Name", "ShirtTemplate"}
    elseif className == "Pants" then
        props = {"Name", "PantsTemplate"}
    elseif className == "BodyColors" then
        props = {"Name", "HeadColor3", "LeftArmColor3", "LeftLegColor3", "RightArmColor3", "RightLegColor3", "TorsoColor3"}
    elseif className == "Humanoid" then
        props = {"Name", "Health", "MaxHealth", "WalkSpeed", "JumpPower", "HipHeight", "DisplayDistanceType", "HealthDisplayType", "NameDisplayDistance", "RigType"}
    elseif className == "SurfaceGui" or className == "BillboardGui" then
        props = {"Name", "Enabled", "Active", "AlwaysOnTop", "LightInfluence", "MaxDistance", "Size", "StudsOffset", "Adornee", "Face"}
    elseif className == "Frame" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex"}
    elseif className == "TextLabel" or className == "TextButton" or className == "TextBox" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex", "Text", "TextColor3", "TextSize", "Font", "TextScaled", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeColor3", "TextStrokeTransparency", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment"}
    elseif className == "ImageLabel" or className == "ImageButton" then
        props = {"Name", "Visible", "Size", "Position", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel", "BorderColor3", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex", "Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "ScaleType", "SliceCenter", "SliceScale"}
    elseif className == "UIAspectRatioConstraint" then
        props = {"Name", "AspectRatio", "AspectType", "DominantAxis"}
    elseif className == "UICorner" then
        props = {"Name", "CornerRadius"}
    elseif className == "UIGradient" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Transparency", "Enabled", "Rotation", "Offset"}
    elseif className == "UIStroke" then
        props = {"Name", "Color", "Thickness", "Transparency", "ApplyStrokeMode", "LineJoinMode", "Enabled"}
    elseif className == "UIPadding" then
        props = {"Name", "PaddingBottom", "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight", "PaddingTop"}
    elseif className == "UIListLayout" or className == "UIGridLayout" then
        props = {"Name", "FillDirection", "HorizontalAlignment", "SortOrder", "VerticalAlignment", "Padding"}
    else
        props = {"Name"}
    end
    return props
end

local function getDefaultValue(className, prop)
    if not defaultCache[className] then
        defaultCache[className] = {}
        local success, defaultObj = pcall(function() return Instance.new(className) end)
        if success and defaultObj then
            local props = getProperties(className)
            for _, p in ipairs(props) do
                pcall(function()
                    defaultCache[className][p] = defaultObj[p]
                end)
            end
            defaultObj:Destroy()
        end
    end
    return defaultCache[className][prop]
end

local idCounter = 0
local opsCounter = 0 
local processedObjects = 0
local totalObjects = 0
local MAX_OPS_PER_FRAME = 1000

local function countObjects(obj)
    if blacklist[obj.ClassName] or obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction") then 
        return 
    end
    totalObjects = totalObjects + 1
    for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        countObjects(child)
    end
end

local function serialize(obj, parentId)
    if blacklist[obj.ClassName] or obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction") then 
        return 
    end

    idCounter = idCounter + 1
    local currentId = idCounter
    
    opsCounter = opsCounter + 1
    processedObjects = processedObjects + 1
    
    if opsCounter >= MAX_OPS_PER_FRAME then
        opsCounter = 0
        local percent = math.floor((processedObjects / totalObjects) * 100)
        print(string.format("Progress: %d%% (%d / %d instances)", percent, processedObjects, totalObjects))
        task.wait()
    end

    Output = Output .. string.format("v = create(\"%s\")\n", obj.ClassName)
    Output = Output .. string.format("refs[%d] = v\n", currentId)
    
    local props = getProperties(obj.ClassName)
    
    for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
        pcall(function()
            local currentVal = obj[prop]
            local defaultVal = getDefaultValue(obj.ClassName, prop)
            
            if currentVal ~= defaultVal then
                Output = Output .. string.format("v.%s = %s\n", prop, cleanValue(currentVal))
            end
        end)
    end
    
    if parentId then
        Output = Output .. string.format("v.Parent = refs[%d]\n\n", parentId)
    else
        Output = Output .. "v.Parent = game:GetService(\"Workspace\")\n\n"
    end
    
    for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        serialize(child, currentId)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    print("Counting objects...")
    for _, child in ipairs(Target:GetChildren()) do
        if not game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(child) then
            countObjects(child)
        end
    end
    
    print(string.format("Objects to serialize: %d. Starting dump...", totalObjects))
    Output = Output .. "local v\n"
    
    for _, child in ipairs(Target:GetChildren()) do
        if not game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(child) then
            serialize(child, nil)
        end
    end
    
    Output = Output .. "table.clear(refs)\n"

    if setclipboard or toclipboard then
        local clipFunc = setclipboard or toclipboard
        clipFunc(Output)
        print("Done! Copied to clipboard.")
    else
        print("Done! Clipboard not supported.")
    end
    
    table.clear(defaultCache)
end)

scripts.title: FIGHT IN A SUPERMARKET KEYLESS
scripts.script:
-- Lilrabbi7416 Killaura + Bring GUI
local Whitelisted = {} 
local killauraEnabled = false
local bringEnabled = false
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function isWhitelisted(player)
for _, name in ipairs(Whitelisted) do
if name == player.Name then return true end
end
return false
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getWeapon()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if v:FindFirstChild("WeaponHitEvent") then
return v end
end
return nil
end

local function optimizeWeapon(weapon)
pcall(function()
if weapon:GetAttribute("BaseCooldown") then weapon:SetAttribute("BaseCooldown", 0.25) end
if weapon:GetAttribute("AnimationTime") then
weapon:SetAttribute("AnimationTime", 0.35) end
         end)
end

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SiriusSoftwareLtd/Rayfield/main/source.lua'))()

local function getClosestPlayer()
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
local closest, dist = nil, 500
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and not isWhitelisted(plr) then
local char = plr.Character
local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if root and head then
local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
if d < dist then
dist = d
closest = plr
end
end
end
end
return closest
end

-- Custom Loading Screen
Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "made by Lilrabbi7416",
    Content = "Killaura + Bring loaded successfully",
    Duration = 6,
    Image = 4483362458,
})

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Lilrabbi7416 Hub",
    LoadingTitle = "made by Lilrabbi7416",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Killaura + Bring",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "Lilrabbi7416",
        FileName = "KillauraConfig"
    }
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
local WhitelistTab = Window:CreateTab("Whitelist", 4483362458)

local killauraConnection
local function startKillaura()
if killauraConnection then return end
killauraConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not killauraEnabled then return end
local weapon = getWeapon()
if not weapon then return end
optimizeWeapon(weapon)
local remote = weapon:FindFirstChild("WeaponHitEvent")
if not remote then return end
local target = getClosestPlayer()
if not target or not target.Character then return end
local hitPart = target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if hitPart then remote:FireServer(hitPart) end
end)
end

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Killaura (Auto Fire)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "KillauraToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        killauraEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            startKillaura()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Killaura", Content = "Enabled - Attacking closest player", Duration = 4})
        else
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Killaura", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

local bringConnection
local function startBring()
if bringConnection then return end
bringConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not bringEnabled then return end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(myRoot + Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5), 0, math.random(-5,5)))
end
end
end)
end

WhitelistTab:CreateParagraph({Title = "Whitelist System", Content = "Whitelisted players will NOT be attacked by Killaura."})

local PlayerDropdown
local function refreshPlayerList()
local playerNames = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(playerNames, plr.Name) end
end
return playerNames
end

PlayerDropdown = WhitelistTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Select Player",
    Options = refreshPlayerList(),
    CurrentOption = {},
    MultipleOptions = false,
    Flag = "PlayerSelect",
    Callback = function() end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Whitelist Selected Player",
    Callback = function()
        local selected = PlayerDropdown.CurrentOption[1]
        if selected and not table.find(Whitelisted, selected) then
            table.insert(Whitelisted, selected)
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = selected .. " has been whitelisted", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Bring Everyone (Client-Sided)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "BringToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        bringEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            startBring()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Bring", Content = "Everyone is now being pulled to you (client only)", Duration = 5})
        else
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Bring", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Unwhitelist Selected Player",
    Callback = function()
        local selected = PlayerDropdown.CurrentOption[1]
        if selected then
            for i, name in ipairs(Whitelisted) do
                if name == selected then
                    table.remove(Whitelisted, i)
                    Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = selected .. " has been removed", Duration = 4})
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Refresh Player List",
    Callback = function() PlayerDropdown:Refresh(refreshPlayerList()) end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Clear All Whitelist",
    Callback = function()
        Whitelisted = {}
        Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = "All players unwhitelisted", Duration = 4})
    end,
})

print("Lilrabbi7416 Hub loaded successfully!")
